## About Rudraansh Yatra

Rudraansh Yatra is a NIDHI-certified, MSME-registered local ground tour operator headquartered in Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand, India. Founded in 2015 by Dheerendra Rautela, a native of the Kumaon Himalayas, the company directly executes Himalayan pilgrimages and adventure treks with zero outsourcing and zero middlemen.

**Type**: LocalBusiness / TravelAgency / TourOperator  
**Founded**: 2015  
**Founder**: Dheerendra Rautela (native of Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand)  
**Headquarters**: 1st Floor Above Maniram Punetha & Sons, Simalgair Bazaar, Pithoragarh, Uttarakhand — 262501, India  
**Coordinates**: 29.5855307, 80.212559  
**Phone**: +91 7617617651  
**Email**: info@rudraanshyatra.com  
**Website**: https://rudraanshyatra.com  

## Certifications

- **MSME Registration**: UDYAM-UK-09-0012985 (Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of India)
- **NIDHI Certification**: EUK000357 (Ministry of Tourism, Government of India)
- **TripAdvisor**: Traveller's Choice recognition

## Tours & Services (all directly executed from Pithoragarh)

1. **Adi Kailash & Om Parvat Yatra**
   - From Pithoragarh: 3 Days / 2 Nights — ₹18,000 per person
   - From Kathgodam: 6 Days / 5 Nights — ₹30,000 per person
   - From Delhi: 6 Days / 5 Nights — ₹35,000 per person
   - URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/adi-kailash

2. **Khaliya Top Alpine Trek**
   - 4 Days / 3 Nights — ₹9,500 per person (from Munsiyari)
   - URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/khaliya-top

3. **Darma Valley Exploration**
   - 5 Days / 4 Nights — ₹24,999 per person
   - URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/darma-valley

4. **Mt. Kailash Yatra** (coordination and support)
   - URL: https://rudraanshyatra.com/mt-kailash

## Areas Served

- Vyas Valley (Adi Kailash route)
- Darma Valley
- Pithoragarh district
- Kumaon Himalayas
- Uttarakhand (border zones with Inner Line Permit coverage)

## Key Differentiators

- 100% direct ground operation — no outsourcing to third parties
- Own fleet of 4×4 Mahindra Bolero vehicles
- Local guides native to Kumaon borderlands
- Direct processing of Inner Line Permits at Pithoragarh & Dharchula SDM offices
- Local homestay partnerships (Vyas Valley, Darma Valley — Rung tribal homestays)
- Emergency safety: oxygen cylinders, oximeters, first-aid kits on all high-altitude trips
- Network with SDM offices, local police, and ITBP military checkpoints
